technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochrsi recovery signal, but severe bearish structure (price below key MAs, negative MACD, below Ichimoku cloud) and weak momentum indicators prevent high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: LYV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 28 days with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (389.1) with FOMC event today creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 28 days adds secondary binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 and 14) with StochRSI bullish cross-up in fear-zone environment (VIX 34 equivalent) offers contrarian mean-reversion setup near support at 104.1.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe bearish structure (price below all key MAs, negative MACD/CMF/AO, below Ichimoku cloud) combined with FOMC event today, earnings in 28 days, zero fundamental catalysts, and crisis-level VIX volatility regime creates unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold with StochRSI bullish cross offers contrarian setup at support, but severe bearish structure (price below all key MAs, negative MACD/CMF/AO, below Ichimoku cloud) combined with FOMC event today and earnings in 28 days creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC volatility spike today combined with crisis-level VIX (389.1 regime) and 28-day earnings binary event could trigger sharp stop-loss execution before mean-reversion completes.
